definitions.explanation: The person who owns or possesses something. Can refer to the owner of physical objects or the possessor of qualities or abilities.

examples.english: Who is the owner of this car?

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The owner of the lost item was found.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
examples.english: She is the possessor of wonderful talent.

notes:
{持|も}ち{主|ぬし} combines ⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (holding, from ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧) + ⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (master, owner). It refers to the owner of objects or the possessor of qualities and abilities.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: the owner of ~
- ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: owner of lost property
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: person of talent
- {美声|びせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: person with a beautiful voice
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: possessor of mysterious power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: owner (everyday, also for abstract qualities)
- ⟦{所有者|しょゆうしゃ}→所有者：21212_shoyuusha⟧: owner (formal, legal contexts, objects only)
- ⟦オーナー→オーナー：10830_oonaa⟧: owner (business, loanword)

USAGE:
Unlike ⟦{所有者|しょゆうしゃ}→所有者：21212_shoyuusha⟧, which is limited to physical or legal ownership, {持|も}ち{主|ぬし} is frequently used for personal qualities: {優|やさ}しさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{主|ぬし} (a kind person).
